entries.0306a02d3a55d0b7: Its guiding principles are: 'Treat every student as one's own child and instruct them strictly,' 'Develop academic ability, willpower and physical strength,' and 'Take responsibility for seeing every student admitted to their first-choice school.' In its medium- to long-term management strategy, the company says that, with an eye to expanding business across the whole of Kyushu in the future, it has entered Okinawa as a new challenge and is working to strengthen its management base in its home city of Kagoshima, and it lists strengthening brand power, developing personnel and promoting management efficiency as issues. As priority issues, it cites its DX efforts, including Subaru LMS with AI, Subaru AI Hisshō Navi, live streaming of group lessons and Subaru Kobetsu Online; responding to the declining birthrate and declining academic ability; and strengthening recruitment activities.

entries.2301cd15b18d3c59: This is a single-segment business that plans and operates cram schools for preschool children, elementary, junior high and high school students, and high school graduates. As of February 28, 2026, it operated 62 campuses in Kagoshima, Miyazaki, Kumamoto, Fukuoka and Okinawa prefectures; revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥3,375 million, and the number of employees was 300. It also operates video lessons using Nagase Co., Ltd.'s Tōshin Satellite Prep School system.
entries.3666268fd033e2ef: This division targets high school students and high school graduates; revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥457 million. In the Okinawa Division, in response to the decline in rōnin students, it is shifting operations to focus mainly on current high school students.
entries.4ad7f0e8de45022c: It runs cram schools in the early childhood and elementary, junior high, senior high and individual instruction divisions, and also offers satellite lectures from Tōshin Eisei Yobikō. It also provides individually optimized learning support by linking mock examination data to Subaru LMS, an AI-powered self-study support system.

entries.b589a22e16451554: Its origins lie in Tsurumaru Yobikō, founded in Kagoshima City in 1965, and it has a community-based network of 31 campuses in Kagoshima Prefecture, as well as Juken La Salle instruction for students aiming for well-known private schools such as La Salle Junior and Senior High School.
